title: Skin Care While Wearing a Face Mask All Day: Smog Season Guide
ex: How to stop mask breakouts, dryness and nose-bridge marks on N95 and cloth-mask days, with a simple morning-to-night routine for Indian winters.
rt: Skin Care While Wearing a Face Mask All Day | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care while wearing a face mask all day: a thin moisturiser first, mask breaks, avoiding mask breakouts and nose marks, plus a smog-season routine.
keyword: skin care while wearing face mask
quick: Apply a thin moisturiser 5 to 10 minutes before putting on a clean mask, keep makeup off the mask area and use sunscreen on uncovered skin. Take short breaks in clean air, change damp masks, wash cloth masks after each use and cleanse gently at night.
facts: Trapped heat, sweat and rubbing cause mask bumps
Use a thinner layer of cream under a mask
Wash cloth masks after every use
